headline: No plausible pairwise harm pathway is documented; both open-source profiles are non-runnable and expose no shared I/O or write surfaces.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Neither profile exposes a shared communication channel, writable filesystem, clipboard, or MCP surface. awesome-selfhosted is non-runnable and has no I/O surfaces; spring-integration-samples is also non-runnable with no I/O surfaces. Without a bridge, prompt injection between them is provably blocked.
conditions: IF either profile gains a shared filesystem, clipboard, or MCP bridge, reassess injection risk.
IF either agent becomes runnable with parser-driven tool use, reassess.
mitigations: Keep both agents non-runnable in this deployment.
Do not add shared clipboard or shared workspace access.
Require explicit provenance tagging before any cross-agent content transfer.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Both profiles report network_egress:none and touch no data classes, so there is no documented path for one agent to leak the other's data. No shared workspace or authenticated principal is described, and the pair is open-source docs-only rather than an active data-processing deployment.
conditions: IF either agent is connected to a shared workspace containing sensitive files, reassess.
IF either agent is granted network egress or uploads file contents by default, reassess.
mitigations: Keep network egress disabled for both agents.
Avoid mounting a shared sensitive workspace.
Separate credentials and principals if either agent is later made runnable.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No overlapping write-capable surfaces are documented. Both profiles have empty io_surfaces, empty permissions_requested, and empty concurrency_model, so there is no evidenced filesystem, git, database, or OAuth write conflict between them.
conditions: IF either agent is given write access to the same directory or mutable resource, reassess.
IF an orchestrator adds shared locking-free state, reassess.
mitigations: Do not co-locate them on a shared mutable workspace.
Add explicit locking before any future shared writes.

D_cascading_error.rationale: There is no documented pipeline where one agent's output becomes the other's authoritative input. Both profiles are non-runnable knowledge repositories/samples with no action-taking authority, so cascading operational errors are not evidenced.
conditions: IF one agent's output is wired into the other's decision path without verification, reassess.
IF either agent is later granted action-taking authority, reassess.
mitigations: Insert a human verification step between agents.
Avoid auto-ingesting one agent's text as instructions for the other.

E_compliance.rationale: No data residency, retention, certification, or regulated data classes are documented for either profile. Because both touch no data classes and are docs-only/open-source artifacts, there is no evidenced compliance mismatch to score.
conditions: IF either profile is later used with regulated data such as PHI or EU PII, reassess.
IF residency or retention policies are introduced and differ, reassess.
mitigations: Set retention and residency policies explicitly.
Review compliance obligations before connecting either agent to real user data.
